title: acme-solution: new solution
subtitle: The new solution chain on acme-solution: each step's page, what it found, what is still open, and whether the chain is done.

verdict.text: The solution does not hold together yet: two parts sit outside the EU and the cost is over budget. Both are decisions for the client, then one rerun of the blueprint and the AI review.

sections.title: The chain
sections.intro: Every step ran today; none was reused from an earlier day.

items.title: solution-brief · 2026-11-11 · ok
items.text: Four specialists needed: AI, data, software, cloud; budget EUR 6,000 a month; EU only.

items.title: ai-pattern, ai-stack, ai-architecture · 2026-11-11 · ok
items.text: A routed workflow with two models; the stack priced from the table; the architecture with the trust view.

items.title: data-platform, data-model · 2026-11-11 · ok
items.text: A warehouse on the managed service; the claims star with one fact.

items.title: arch-style, arch-c4 · 2026-11-11 · ok
items.text: A modular monolith; three levels drawn.

items.title: cloud-design · 2026-11-11 · watch
items.text: Containers on the app platform in West Europe; the backup store landed in West US 2.

items.title: solution-blueprint · 2026-11-11 · risk
items.text: Nine conflicts, seven real: two region breaches, one database named twice, the cost over budget by EUR 1,360.

items.title: ai-review, data-review, arch-review, cloud-review · 2026-11-11 · watch
items.text: Two review findings: no retention for AI drafts, no single sign-on in any page.

items: solution-blueprint: the backup store in West US 2 and the model endpoint in East US break the EU-only rule (high)
solution-blueprint: the total of EUR 7,360 is over the EUR 6,000 budget (high)
ai-review: seven-year retention of AI drafts is in the brief and on no page

blocks.text: **Rule:** The chain is done when the blueprint has no open high conflict and no review verdict is bad. **Answer:** no, open high conflicts.

items: Move the backup store and the model endpoint to an EU region, then rerun solution-blueprint.
Decide what drops to fit the budget: the second node pool or the second model.
Add retention and single sign-on to the architecture and rerun ai-review.
